question_text: The President nominates a new Secretary of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR). Which of the following best describes the role of the Commission on Appointments (CA) in this process?

options.text: The CA must confirm the appointment by a majority vote of all its members.
The CA must confirm the appointment by a two-thirds vote of all its members.
The CA has no role because the DENR Secretary is a department head whose appointment does not require CA confirmation.
The CA must confirm the appointment only if the nominee is not a natural-born citizen.
